leads.title: Equal Opportunities Act 2006
leads.documents: Prohibits discrimination in employment and provision of goods and services on grounds including sexual orientation and gender reassignment; defines gender reassignment as process for reassigning sex
leads.detail: Came into force 1 March 2007; definitions quoted in Discrimination protections section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Crimes Act 2011 - gender-neutral
leads.documents: Sets equal age of consent at 16 regardless of sexual orientation; reflects Supreme Court decision; decriminalised heterosexual anal sex
leads.detail: Approved August 2011, took effect 23 November 2012; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Amendment to Crimes Act 2011 on hate crime 2013 - Gibraltar Parliament
leads.documents: Criminalises hatred and harassment on ground of sexual orientation as hate crime
leads.detail: Approved 19 September 2013, royal assent 25 September, took effect 10 October 2013; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Parliament bill July 2026 amending hate crime and hate speech legislation
leads.documents: Adds protections for transgender identity to hate crime and hate speech legislation
leads.detail: Passed July 2026 per Hate crime legislation section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Parliament bill July 2026 on conversion therapy
leads.documents: Makes it an offence to offer or practice conversion therapy
leads.detail: Passed July 2026 per Conversion therapy section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Civil Marriage Amendment Act 2016
leads.documents: Legalises same-sex marriage in Gibraltar; requires alternative registrar if deputy registrar opts out
leads.detail: Passed 26 October 2016 unanimously, royal assent 1 November, took effect 15 December 2016; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Supreme Court of Gibraltar ruling 8 April 2011
leads.documents: Ruled higher age of consent of 18 for gay sex unconstitutional; mandated equal age of 16
leads.detail: Dated 8 April 2011; sought after March 2010 referral on discrimination under European Council principles; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Supreme Court ruling 10 April 2013 on Adoption Act 1951 section 5(2)
leads.documents: Ruled section 5(2) in violation of Gibraltar Constitution, in effect legalising LGBT adoption; led to civil partnership law and Adoption Act 2023
leads.detail: Dated 10 April 2013; challenge by long-term lesbian couple denied adoption after IVF child; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Foreign Affairs Committee enquiry into the overseas territories 2008
leads.documents: Government report recommending discrimination on basis of sexual orientation or gender status be made illegal in all overseas territories
leads.detail: Quoted recommendation: We recommend that the Government should take steps to ensure that discrimination...; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Nadine Rodriguez v. Minister for Housing of the Government of Gibraltar & ORS
leads.documents: Documented incident of lesbian couple denied shared rental agreement by Gibraltar Housing Allocation Committee; local court Dec 2008 ruled for couple, Supreme Court May 2009 reaffirmed, Privy Council London successful
leads.detail: Case name and timeline 2008-2009 visible in Activism section; also cited as Rodriguez v Minister of Housing in See also; no URL visible in text
